title: 급식 줄 한 칸 뒤
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop bubblegum pop track in G Major at 124 BPM. The arrangement features a bright, syncopated electric bassline with a slap-like attack and a clean, funk-style electric guitar playing rhythmic staccato chords. Percussion consists of a crisp electronic snare and a tight kick drum. High-pitched female vocals utilize a mix of rhythmic delivery and melodic phrasing. Synthesizer layers include bright, percussive pads and subtle melodic bells. The production is polished with high-end clarity and tight compression on the vocal track.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[bright synth bells, funk electric guitar, slap bass]

[Verse 1]
[female vocals]
내 시간 종일 울려 복도를 천천히 걸어

일부러 느리게 가
운동화 끈 고쳐 매 거울 한 번 더 봐
손끝이 차가워
네 뒤에서 걷고 싶어 딱 한 칸 뒤에
오늘도 타이밍 맞춰

[Chorus]
[full percussion enters]
급식 줄 한 칸 뒤에
메뉴판 읽는 척해

비밀이야 이건
친구가 왜 느냐고 물어 배 안 고프다 거짓말
